The read logs confirm the fitted-row values (limited-550-A smooth 0.00017418 cold 7.7237 s; diverted-2000-A smooth 0.00050917 saddle 2.7397e-05 axis 4.2233e-15 X 1.1102e-15), the arm-B failure (quadratic-diverted-2000.json smooth_membership_error 1.0000000000001255, x_error_m null), the limited 10,000 invalidity (reason 7 = UNRESOLVED_COMPONENT, warm 80.62665932811797 s, valid false) and the diverted 5,000 wall (map-diverted-5000-1283109.log ends on stage=machine with no completion; h200-map-control.log shows four MAP_ROW EXIT=0 then JOB 1283109 CANCELLED). The declared negative control fires: the 132-cell rows record reproduced_smooth_error equal to baseline_smooth_error to machine precision (limited 0.0008381308076390344 both; diverted reproduced 0.0017729086428399958 vs baseline 0.0017729086428390293, saddle reproduced 0.0006491472240741125 vs baseline 0.0006491472240733251). Not higher because the report's own primary cost table does not render (see finding 1), so the numbers the report exists to convey are not reachable as a table from the document alone.
justifications.fit: Follows the report conventions: a method-and-controls preamble that states the two arms and the carrier relation before use, per-rung tables with a job id and log path on every row, an explicit distinction between the production fixed-design map and the prototype read arms, a stated non-claim ('No forward solve was run'), and a candid verdict that does not overclaim. Kept from full marks by the structural defect in the forward-map cost table (finding 1) and by the residual/convergence clause being reported as absent rather than bounded.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node's done-when asks for a report covering, for both the weak-rotation limited and the diverted single-null analytic states at 550, 2,000, 5,000 and 10,000 realised cells, two arms (A the current defaults, B the simplest representation the code admits), giving map fidelity (relative sup), smooth/saddle membership error, axis and X-point position error in metres and pitches, limiter contact error, the forward-solve terminal residual and convergence, cold compile, warm execute, device memory and host RSS; plus fitted orders, the cell count where each arm meets each section-6 acceptance bound, the rung where memory or wall binds and which structure binds, and a verdict on arm B. All four deliverable shapes are present and the decision question is answered as far as measured: the diverted arm B loses its X-point at 2,000 and exceeds the saddle budget at 5,000, and the binding costs are identified (serialized executable 359.7/360.2 MB at 2,000 against the 50 MB bound; the diverted 5,000-cell machine construction exceeding 30 minutes). Not full marks because the map ladder stops at 2,000 realised cells (the requested 5,000 and 10,000 map rows are absent, and the diverted 10,000 read is missing entirely) and the forward-solve terminal residual / convergence clause was not measured at all (no forward solve was run), so the end-to-end term of the done-when is carried only by the map-fidelity proxy.
justifications.reuse: Reuses the repository's existing machinery rather than adding a solver: benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py with its requested-cells argument and the analytic-oracle fixtures for the map, and nova.equilibrium.topology.read with TopologyPolicy for the two read arms; the shared environment and the rung-ordered single-allocation submission pattern (one job looping its rows inside the allocation, each row persisted) are followed. New machinery is confined to the prototype driver and the report builder under scripts/prototypes/ladder. It measures the resolution pivot as an input to the lead's decision rather than changing production code.
justifications.scope_discipline: The reviewed worktree at head 598110c181df7ef7a3749808a5dd2df587c8e6ab adds exactly the seven declared files under scripts/prototypes/ladder (map.py 254, measure.py 181, quadratic.py 71, report.py 405, run.sh 33, run_map.sh 35, run_quadratic.sh 24 lines; 1,003 insertions, no deletions), all inside the node's declared write paths; no file under nova/ or tests/ is touched, as the brief requires of prototype code. The worktree is clean (git status empty; only ignored caches). The report is written to its granted external path. No plan, sprint or index mutation, no push.
